vo.text: A Costco rotisserie chicken, in hot dogs? **About 3.3.**

notes: Stress variant: 7 rungs, long labels, a fractional count and a 6-figure count. Maths at $1.50 per hot dog + soda: $4.99 ÷ 1.50 = 3.327; $65 ÷ 1.50 = 43.33; $249 ÷ 1.50 = 166; $1,099 ÷ 1.50 = 732.67; $11,950 ÷ 1.50 = 7,966.67; $50,000 ÷ 1.50 = 33,333.3; $410,000 ÷ 1.50 = 273,333.3; 273,333 ÷ 365 = 748.9 years. Prices: Costco rotisserie chicken $4.99 and hot dog combo $1.50 (unchanged for years), Gold Star membership $65 (since Sept 2024), AirPods Pro 3 $249 and iPhone 17 Pro 256 GB $1,099 (US launch, Sept 2025), public 4-year in-state tuition and fees $11,950 (College Board 2025-26), average new car ≈ $50,000 (Kelley Blue Book, late 2025), median existing-home price ≈ $410,000 (NAR, 2025).
